data.notes: Aspen’s February 2027 confirmed music calendar is anchored by Palm Tree Music Festival, with smaller confirmed theater and community dance events around it while several winter club/après lineups remain unannounced.

events.title: Palm Tree Music Festival Aspen 2027
events.summary: Palm Tree Music Festival returns to Aspen for two days of electronic music with The Chainsmokers, FISHER + Chris Lake, Disco Lines, HUGEL, The Martinez Brothers, Max Styler, and more.

events.title: Wheeler Presents: An Evening with Jesse Cook
events.summary: Juno-winning guitarist Jesse Cook brings his flamenco, jazz, and global-fusion live show to Wheeler Opera House at 7:30 pm.

events.title: Wheeler Presents MANIA: The ABBA Tribute
events.summary: MANIA: The ABBA Tribute performs a pop tribute concert at Wheeler Opera House at 7:30 pm.

events.title: JAS Community Nights – Salsa Night with Mezcla Socials Dance
events.summary: Jazz Aspen Snowmass hosts a free salsa community night with Mezcla Socials Dance, including a 6:00 pm lesson and open dancing from 7:00 pm.
